evidence.why: Access policy, filename lookup and handle creation.

facts.rationale: Preserves the file-lifecycle mapping while including the explicit identity-bypass branch.
facts.value: Implements filename-based opening of a GameCube memory-card file, converting accessible directory metadata into a CARDFileInfo handle. Lookup normally requires matching game/company identifiers, but accepts occupied entries regardless of those identifiers when card->diskID == &__CARDDiskNone; it does not use the public-permission fallback.

evidence.why: Complete lookup policy and open implementation.

facts.rationale: Replaces unconditional ownership validation with the actual accessibility policy.
facts.value: Opens a memory-card file by filename, resolving the first occupied entry admitted by __CARDAccess and validating its starting block before initializing CARDFileInfo. Access requires matching game/company identifiers unless card->diskID == &__CARDDiskNone; unlike CARDFastOpen, named lookup does not retry ownership denial through public permission.

facts.rationale: Retains failure and initialization ordering without excluding bypass-authorized files.
facts.value: Sets fileInfo->chan to -1 before acquiring the control block. Acquisition failure returns immediately; lookup failure leaves the handle invalid; an invalid start block yields CARD_RESULT_BROKEN. A successful accessible-name lookup, including the &__CARDDiskNone identity-bypass case, plus a valid start block initializes chan, fileNo, offset = 0 and iBlock. Every successfully acquired control block is released with the final result.

facts.rationale: Corrects the claimed unconditional ownership boundary.
facts.value: Implements filename-to-directory-slot resolution for GameCube memory-card files under __CARDAccess policy: occupied entries normally require matching game and company identifiers, while card->diskID == &__CARDDiskNone bypasses those comparisons. Public permission alone does not admit an entry to this search.

facts.rationale: Preserves exceptional argument ordering and identity bypass while accurately summarizing handle state.
facts.value: Empty directory slots are rejected before access checks. Occupied entries are accessible on matching game/company identifiers or when diskID == &__CARDDiskNone; CARDFastOpen additionally retries ownership denial through public permission. CARDFastOpen returns FATAL_ERROR for an out-of-range file number before touching fileInfo. Otherwise both open paths invalidate chan before control acquisition and initialize chan/fileNo/offset/iBlock only after successful selection and starting-block validation. Close leaves the handle unchanged on acquisition failure and otherwise invalidates only chan. __CARDIsOpened always returns FALSE and tracks no handle state.
